description:
Your All-In-One AI Platform.

LynxHub offers a comprehensive suite of features designed to streamline your AI workflow and enhance your experience. Here's what you can expect:
- Extensible Architecture
  - Enhance LynxHub's capabilities with custom extensions.
- Modular Design
  - Fully modular architecture allowing third-party developers to create and publish custom modules
  - Modules can add new AI web interfaces (WebUIs) to the app, fully customizable by the developer
  - Developers can pre-define custom arguments, extensions, commands, and other configurations as part of the module, creating pre-configured WebUIs for users
- AI Interface Management
  - Install, config and update
  - Switch branches, shallow clone, unshallow, see latest commit details
  - Manage AI extensions with options for batch updates and auto-update settings
  - View available extensions and install them directly
- Arguments Manager
  - Available arguments list, add, remove, and edit various argument types (dropdowns, checkboxes, text input, folder/file selection - relative, absolute)
  - Search through arguments
  - Create and manage argument presets for different setups
- Custom Run Commands
  - Set and manage custom terminal commands for executing WebUI
- Pre-launch Actions
  - Automatically execute custom terminal commands before launching AI interfaces
  - Open specific files or folders as part of the pre-launch process
- Browser and Terminal Integration
  - Built-in terminal and web browser for seamless integration
  - Automatic detection and launch of relevant addresses (URLs, files)
  - Switch easily between terminal and browser modes
  - Terminal customization settings
- Markdown Viewer
  - Built-in Markdown viewer for easy reading of documentation and notes.
- AI Information Dashboard
  - View developer information, installation and update status
  - Access update tags, release notes, and disk usage statistics for each AI interface
- UI Customization
  - Customize the layout of cards for a flexible user interface
  - Dark and light themes available
  - Pin favorite AI interfaces to the home page for easy access
This release is a massive update packed with highly requested features and major under-the-hood architectural upgrades. Introduced Quick Web for lightning-fast browsing, robust Tab and Session management with crash recovery, and an all-new Bookmarks system.
Behind the scenes, i've completely overhauled the app's core migrating configurations to SQLite, revamping plugin distribution with ZIP archives, and replacing external binaries with high-performance native workers. Together, these upgrades deliver significantly faster startup times, vastly reduced memory usage, memory leak fixes, and a noticeably smoother user experience.
Note
LynxHub now lives in the TheLynxHub organization.
✨ New Features
- Added Quick Web
  - Load your favorite web pages instantly!
  - Features a floating window with a customizable hotkey (Defaults to ALT+W).
  - Preloads web pages so they are immediately ready to show.
  - Supports shared or separated sessions (cookies, logins, caches).
- Added Bookmarks to easily save and manage your favorite pages.
- Tab & Session Management Overhaul:
  - Added tab and session persistence, crash recovery, and closed tab history.
  - Automatically restore closed tabs (browser, terminal, running AI, pages) on startup.
  - Added a new top banner prompting you to restore tabs after an app crash.
  - Added a right-click context menu to tabs (Show icon only, Pin, Close, Close others, Close to the right, Reopen closed).
  - Added the ability to pin a tab directly.
- Added a Session option (available via the card menu or CTRL-Click) to open a clean session in the installation folder.
- SQLite Configuration Migration:
  - Migrated core config from LowDB (JSON) to SQLite (DB).
  - Fixed memory leaks and crashes caused by large config files.
  - App now starts faster with significantly lower memory usage.
  - Automatic backups prevent config loss during crashes.
- ZIP-based Plugin & Statics Distribution:
  - Migrated the Plugins and Statics systems from Git operations to ZIP archives.
  - Delivers vastly faster installation and updating of plugins/statics.
  - Keeps a two-version rotation, automatically loading the backup if the latest version fails.
  - Fixes previous loading/updating errors and reduces download size and disk usage.
- Native Size Calculation:
  - Replaced the external du64 binary with a native NodeJS worker for directory/file size calculation.
  - No longer requires a separate binary download.
  - Up to 3x faster calculation, especially for large folders.
- WebContentView Migration:
  - Migrated submenus from dedicated windows to the lightweight WebContentView.
  - Enabled all features on Linux.
  - Faster performance with reduced hardware usage.
  - Affects: Right-Click Menu, Confirmations, Share Screen, Link Preview, and Download Manager.
- Added a new setting to automatically send an Exit Signal when terminating a process.
- Added layout options to launch config arguments to separate previews for multiple files, including better syntax highlighting for each file.
- Added text import and auto-parsing to the arguments config.
- Added a force refresh option for browser pages (includes a warning to prevent accidental refreshing and losing unsaved work).
- Added command-line support:
  - --unload-plugins: Starts LynxHub without any plugins (extensions/modules).
  - --log-metrics: Logs process metrics.
- Added browser skeleton loading screens that display until the first visual paint.
- Added support for opening local files and paths (file:// protocols) directly from the in-app browser address bar.
- Added a Firefox preset option to the browser user agent settings.
⚡ Improvements
- Optimized settings search for better responsiveness and comprehensive results.
- Improved Tab styles, sizing, animations, and rendering.
- Replaced older decompression methods with a new, highly efficient 7-Zip implementation.
- You can now search for text in the browser directly from the home search bar, or open a URL if one is provided.
- Made most modals dismissable by clicking outside of them.
- Redesigned the welcome window with an improved layout, animated graphics, and stepped progress indicators.
- Improved the overall performance of the installation modal.
- Adjusted the terminal step window size within the installation modal.
- Improved card renaming to dynamically update all associated tabs, modals, and internal references.
- Disabled the thousands grouping separator (commas) in number fields for arguments.
- Removed arguments are now clearly displayed as deprecated in the launch config.
- Better handling of network disconnections and interruptions during the download step in the installation modal.
- Added the ability to rename and delete presets in the launch config.
- Constrained tab reordering (drag-and-drop) to stay strictly within container boundaries.
- Offline-First Authentication:
  - LynxHub now seamlessly preserves your active login state and subscription features while offline without unexpected logouts.
  - Automatically revalidates and refreshes your account status in the background once your internet connection is restored.
  - Added instant sync notifications and connection guards on the profile account page.
- Deep Link Handling:
  - Added support for in-app browser deep links to ensure seamless authentication redirects.
  - Added cold-start deep link support on Windows so LynxHub properly opens and processes authentication links when launched from external browsers or links.
- Smoother & Faster Tab Performance:
  - Optimized tab navigation by hoisting the top navigation bar globally across tabs.
  - Centralized terminal process exit listeners globally instead of attaching listeners per tab, reducing background overhead.
- Tab Modals & Dialogs:
  - Improved modal positioning and rendering to reliably anchor within the active tab while preserving full-window backdrop coverage.
  - Prevented modals and dialogs from accidentally dismissing when selecting or dragging text across the screen.
🐛 Bug Fixes
- Fixed Null byte injection security issues.
- Fixed an issue where renamed card titles reverted to their original names upon restarting LynxHub.
- Fixed an error that occurred when deleting a preset in the launch config.
- Fixed value updating issues in argument number fields.
- Fixed an issue where switching presets in the launch config would incorrectly display old values.
- Fixed inaccurate percentage calculations on the download progress bar.
- Fixed a bug where directory/file selection incorrectly shared a newly selected path in the installation modal.
- Fixed download retries not working in the installation modal.
- Fixed terminal restart glitches, whitespace rendering issues, and scrolling corruption in the installation modal.
- Fixed the clone branch selector in the installation modal failing to fetch and display the default branch correctly.
- Prevented rapid update checks from triggering during periods of high network usage.
- Fixed custom boolean arguments in the launch config failing to parse and apply correctly.
- Fixed a focus loss issue when renaming custom arguments in the launch config.
- Fixed dropdown options for custom arguments in the launch config not displaying or applying correctly.
- Fixed an issue where switching tabs would open or duplicate modals in the new tab.
- Fixed errors triggered when LynxHub attempted to kill a terminal process that no longer existed.
- Fixed terminal search and copy text errors.
- Resolved Git unhandled rejections and added guards for offline operations.
- Fixed terminal WebGL context loss and added guards for resize dimensions.
- Fixed a "switch theme" invalid state error.
- Resolved main process loading errors for plugins.
- Fixed application update check errors.
- Fixed plugin and statics clean-up errors on Linux and macOS.
- Fixed an issue where opening a new address in the browser did not clear previous error pages.
- Fixed an issue where launching LynxHub offline could overwrite user subscription stages or cause unexpected logouts.
- Fixed the pin button state and interaction on custom tools cards.
📌 Minor Changes
- Added home screen notifications, exit animations for categories/buttons, and new reduced-motion accessibility options.
- Updated the style and colors of the custom directory/file selector input in the installation modal.
- Updated animations, layout transitions, and accessibility in the custom arguments menu.
- Implemented loading skeletons and indeterminate states before data retrieval in the installation modal.
- Fixed the theme switch icon size in settings.
- Fixed tab tooltips occasionally flashing in the top right corner.
- Refreshed the design of browser navigation buttons.
- Updated several arrow icons from a bold style to a cleaner, linear style.
- Cleaned up and removed obsolete styling tokens and CSS utilities.
- Reverted the default browser user agent back to LynxHub.
- Added smooth sequential stagger animations when displaying extension category cards.
- Refreshed interface icons across step-progress modals and account profile sections.
⚙️ API and Backend Changes
App
- If a TabModal is set to be dismissable, clicking its title bar will no longer accidentally close the modal.
- Ignored Sentry connection error logging while running in development mode.
- Added an automatic onUserDataChange push event to synchronize user login and logout state in real-time across the app.
- Cleaned up deprecated release channel IPC events and unified release channel listeners under user IPC.
Plugins
- Added a new zipScripts.js utility for auto-compressing scripts after builds.
- Added an optional draft property to the GitHubRelease plugin type definition.
💖 Amazing Supporters
Proudly supported by our community. Thank you for investing in LynxHub’s future.
